issues.description: The UML in the problem statement lists the attribute 'lectureName' as type int, while the intended design (and the reference solution) uses a String for lectureName. This type contradiction in the problem statement can confuse students about the correct type to implement and may lead to incorrect constructor/signature implementations.
issues.suggestedFix: Correct the UML and any problem-statement references to declare lectureName as a String (e.g. lectureName: String). Also clarify in the textual description the intended types for each attribute so students use String for lectureName and int for the numeric attributes.
